announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director shareholding changes are routine governance updates. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for any significant shifts in insider sentiment.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Nominated Adviser and Joint Broker
announcements.insight: H-Power plc appoints a Nominated Adviser and Joint Broker, following an earlier appointment of an Additional Corporate Broker in August. This reinforces its market infrastructure as it advances the Komatsu JDA final phase.

announcements.headline: LC30: Attestation of Conformity for the CE Mark
announcements.insight: This attestation follows the June sale of fuel cell generators. It confirms product compliance for existing commercial deployments.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Additional Corporate Broker
announcements.insight: H-Power plc appoints an additional corporate broker. This follows recent commercial milestones including hydrogen sales and a completed JDA phase.

announcements.headline: Completed Komatsu JDA 1st phase-final phase begins
announcements.insight: H-Power plc has commenced the final phase of its Komatsu JDA. This follows earlier sales of hydrogen and fuel cell generators in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director dealings are routine governance updates. Shareholders should monitor future filings for substantive corporate actions following the recent interim results and sales.

announcements.headline: Sale of 2 LC30 fuel cell generator to TAMGO in KSA
announcements.insight: H-Power plc has sold a fuel cell generator to TAMGO in KSA. This contract provides initial revenue but lacks financial details for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Sale of 5,000 kg of hydrogen from cracked ammonia
announcements.insight: H-Power plc has sold 5,000 kg of hydrogen from cracked ammonia. This initial commercial activity suggests early operational progress for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Interim Results for the half year to 30 April 2026
announcements.insight: H-Power plc has released its interim results for the half year to 30 April 2026. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for financial performance details.
